notablePrerequisites: You've had at least two nontoken creatures put into your graveyard this turn.
description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Caller of the Claw.
When Caller of the Claw enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
